selected_work: R89 hosted vertex-shader input-signature contract smoke for R88 FVF blend-weight/index layouts.
summary: Added a hosted-only semantic ABI smoke that translates representative R88 FVF blend layouts, compiles matching vs_4_0 HLSL with D3DCompile, reflects the vertex-shader input signature with D3DReflect, and compares semantic name/index plus reflected component type/mask against the translated D3D11 input elements. Cases cover XYZB5 split BLENDWEIGHT0/1, UBYTE4 BLENDINDICES as uint4, D3DCOLOR BLENDINDICES as normalized float4, and blend+NORMAL. A deliberate UBYTE4 float4 mismatch must fail closed. Production renderer/runtime translation source was not changed.
evidence: CONVERSION-DX11-00034 completed R88 descriptor-level F19 blend semantics and selected hosted shader-signature/input-contract validation as the next bounded runtime-independent task.
Implementation commit 8d6032689bb79c45e55fbacd8cdd9f7f389d4bcf contains only hosted smoke/build/workflow/verifier changes.
